SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. I. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2878
Date 10. 11. 31.

November 10, 1.

My dear Bos, and Capt. Fieb.

I am sending you herewith some specimens *
of the cartoons which have been circulated in
connection with the anti-Japanese propaganda
campaign.

Yours sincerely,

H. Bos, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

* Enclosure
Specimens of cartoons.
10/XI 31. N.O.P.
